Actors Suriya and Jyothika renew wedding vows

Actors Suriya and Jyothika renewed their wedding vows in a Christian ceremony to commemorate their 20th anniversary. The event was described as intimate. Suriya was reportedly moved to tears during the ceremony, particularly when Jyothika walked down the aisle. The couple exchanged vows in a white wedding style.
